summary: The statement and proof are correct and complete. The explicit positive law satisfies both original coordinate mean equations, and the relative-entropy identities establish unique entropy maximality for each factor and every independent product. Conditional column reflection gives the required noise symmetry, while symmetric independent column marginals give the symmetry of the original-coordinate drift. The scalar principle then applies without requiring independence between drift and noise. Arbitrary real normals, unequal factor parameters, degenerate columns, and zero directions are all covered; the closed-halfspace conclusion follows with the correct containment direction.
